description: Static world objects of map7_s03 (Nowhere - final boss): 12 objects, drawn in file order. An object is drawn while the player is in one of its "zones" (each {"x": [...], "z": [...]} lists 40 m cells along that axis: cell c holds 40c..40(c+1) m; no zones = everywhere) and every flag of "flags_set" is set and every flag of "flags_clear" is clear (event flag names, e.g. the pickup flags). "name" is the object's id for scripts and mods, "model" its model (at most 8 characters, the map's or an item model), "position" in metres and "rotation" in degrees (x, y, z). "script": true lets world_objects.lua and events.lua move, turn, re-model or hide the object. Every object is script-driven (world_objects.lua): Bin, Nu and Baby show with the map variables update_bin, update_nu and update_baby (the ending scenes move the bin and the baby along the cutscene); Real, Ura and Under are three copies each of the scrolling worlds, interleaved as the original drew them. A mod's maps/map7_s03/world_objects.json changes or adds objects by name.
